reason: The test is the xpath engine: Strider's locators take CSS only, and XPath is planned for 1.0

Playwright's selector-string syntax errors: a second `*` capture in one selector, and an unknown engine (`*=div`). Strider has no selector strings, so there's no parser to reject them; its locators are CSS and the chained queries, which the port expresses instead
Locator.evaluate runs in the isolated world, which stock WebKit doesn't have, so it fails Unsupported there before it reads the match (the isolatedWorlds capability)
